items.title_en: JetZero
items.title_zh: JetZero
items.summary_en: JetZero appears to be an aviation-focused project or startup pursuing next-generation aircraft concepts with efficiency and/or low emissions goals. The post likely covers the technology direction, milestones, or partnerships shaping its trajectory.
items.summary_zh: JetZero 似乎是一家聚焦下一代飞机概念的航天创业项目，致力于提升效率和降低排放。该条目可能聚焦技术方向、里程碑与潜在合作对其发展轨迹的影响。

items.title_en: Show HN: I mapped every US golf course
items.title_zh: Show HN：我把美国所有高尔夫球场都映射出来
items.summary_en: An exhaustive map of all US golf courses, likely built from public data and geospatial tooling. The project demonstrates how hobby data projects can scale into useful navigational tools and inspire local-search or tourism apps.
items.summary_zh: 对美国所有高尔夫球场的全面制图，通常结合公开数据与地理信息工具完成。此类业余数据项目展示了如何扩展成实用的导航工具，并为本地搜索或旅游应用提供灵感。

items.title_en: Did They Ghost You?
items.title_zh: 他们真的把你甩了吗？
items.summary_en: A project exploring ghosting in digital communication, Did They Ghost You? collects anecdotes and insights into why people disappear and how to cope. It highlights patterns across dating apps, messaging, and social platforms, offering practical takeaways for readers navigating ambiguous modern communication.
items.summary_zh: 这一项目聚焦数字沟通中的“被甩”现象，汇集相关案例与观察，解析人为何突然消失以及应如何应对。内容覆盖约会应用、即时通讯和社交平台的规律，为在现代沟通中遭遇模糊局面的人提供实用建议。

items.title_en: The new rules of context engineering for Claude 5 generation models
items.title_zh: Claude 5 代模型的上下文工程新规则
items.summary_en: Anthropic outlines new context engineering guidelines for Claude 5 generation models, detailing how to structure prompts, manage context windows, and orchestrate tool use to improve reliability and control. The rules reflect a shift toward modular, auditable prompts and better steerability in long-running interactions.
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 为 Claude 5 代模型制定了新的上下文工程规范，聚焦如何组织提示、管理上下文长度以及协调工具调用以提高稳定性与可控性。此举标志着在长期对话中对可预测性和审计性的重视。

items.title_en: An ESP32 based plane radar for my desk
items.title_zh: 基于 ESP32 的桌面飞机雷达
items.summary_en: A compact ESP32-powered radar project tracks small aircraft movement on a desk, offering real-time visuals from affordable hardware. It demonstrates how hobbyist sensors can mirror core radar concepts and be repurposed for education or dashboards.
items.summary_zh: 一个用 ESP32 做的紧凑雷达项目在桌面上追踪小型飞机，能实时可视化，成本低廉的硬件就能实现。展示了爱好者级传感器如何复现雷达核心原理，并可用于教育或仪表板展示。

items.title_en: DeepSeek pause fundraise after comments on compute gap to US leaked (transcript) [pdf]
items.title_zh: DeepSeek 暂停融资：关于美方算力差距的评论被泄露（文字稿）
items.summary_en: A leaked transcript reveals investor and company discussions about compute gaps relative to the United States, prompting questions about competitiveness and funding dynamics in AI hardware startups.
items.summary_zh: 泄露的文字稿显示投资者与公司讨论相对美国的算力差距，引发对 AI 硬件初创公司竞争力与融资动态的关注。

items.title_en: Android May Soon Restrict On-Device ADB
items.title_zh: Android 可能很快限制设备端 ADB
items.summary_en: Google is tightening on-device ADB controls, requiring user authorization for new hosts and limiting access to trusted contexts. The move aims to shrink the attack surface of debugging tools on Android, but may complicate automation and enterprise workflows. Expect gradual rollout across upcoming Android updates.
items.summary_zh: Android 正在加强对设备端 ADB 的控制，要求对新主机进行授权并限制对受信任环境以外的访问。此举旨在降低调试工具的攻击面，但可能增加自动化与企业工作流的难度。相关改动将会在未来的 Android 更新中逐步落地。

items.title_en: GM Backs Sodium Ion Batteries for U.S. Grid Storage
items.title_zh: 通用汽车支持钠离子电池用于美国电网储能
items.summary_en: GM backs sodium-ion batteries as a viable path for U.S. grid storage, citing cheaper materials and domestic supply abundance. Sodium-ion cells trade some energy density for cost and supply-security advantages, potentially accelerating long-duration storage and reducing reliance on lithium-centric supply chains.
items.summary_zh: 通用汽车宣布支持钠离子电池用于美国电网储能，强调原材料更便宜且来源更分散。钠离子电池与锂电池相比能量密度略低，但在成本和供应安全方面具有潜在优势，或有助于扩大长时段储能部署并减少对锂等供应链的依赖。

items.title_en: Turn And Face The Strange
items.title_zh: 转身面对陌生事物
items.summary_en: An introspective piece about embracing the unknown in tech work—pushing through unfamiliar problems with curiosity and resilience.
items.summary_zh: 关于在科技工作中拥抱未知的反思文章——以好奇心和韧性迎接陌生问题。

items.title_en: Humans haven't stopped evolving
items.title_zh: 人类从未停止进化
items.summary_en: New genetic research shows humans continue evolving under selective pressures, shaping traits like metabolism and disease resistance. The finding contextualizes ongoing biology with technology, medicine, and personalized health implications.
items.summary_zh: 最新基因研究显示人类在持续经历选择压力而进化，影响代谢与疾病抵抗等性状。研究将生物学的持续演化放在技术、医学和个性化健康的语境中讨论。

items.title_en: Claude Opus 5
items.title_zh: Claude Opus 5 发布
items.summary_en: Anthropic unveils Claude Opus 5, the latest model in the Claude Opus line. It marks another step in upgrading instruction-following, safety controls, and performance for enterprise-grade AI assistants.
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 发布 Claude Opus 5，Claude Opus 系列的最新版本，进一步提升了指令遵循、安全控制和企业级 AI 助手的性能。

items.title_en: The growing vigilante movement to knock out Flock surveillance cameras
items.title_zh: Show HN: Awsmux — 多账户 AWS CLI，最高可快 5.4x、令牌更少 7.4x
items.summary_en: Awsmux lets you run commands across multiple AWS accounts from a single CLI session, delivering significant speed-ups and token efficiency. It reduces context-switching friction for teams managing many accounts, boosting productivity of developers and operators.
items.summary_zh: Awsmux 允许在单一 CLI 会话中对多个 AWS 账号执行命令，大幅提升速度并降低令牌使用量。对于需要管理大量账户的团队，能减少上下文切换的成本并提升开发与运维效率。

items.title_en: Open-weight AI is having its Kubernetes moment
items.title_zh: 开放权重 AI 正在迎来 Kubernetes 时刻
items.summary_en: Open-weight AI decouples model weights from compute and is finally seeing Kubernetes-native deployment tooling mature enough for production. This trend lets teams run, scale, and experiment with large models across clusters without tying weights to a single vendor. The shift accelerates collaboration and reproducibility in ML ops.
items.summary_zh: 开放权重AI将模型权重与计算资源解耦，现阶段在云原生部署工具链上逐步成熟，利于企业落地。借助Kubernetes生态进行服务、监控与扩展，能够跨集群运行大模型，降低供应商锁定。该趋势将推动ML运维的协作性与可重复性。

items.title_en: Inflect-Micro-v2: complete voice in 9.36M parameters
items.title_zh: Inflect-Micro-v2：仅用9.36M参数实现完整语音
items.summary_en: Inflect-Micro-v2 is a compact voice model achieving full speech capabilities with only 9.36M parameters, challenging the idea that big models are always necessary. The post likely covers training efficiency, on-device inference, and implications for edge AI.
items.summary_zh: Inflect-Micro-v2 在仅有9.36M参数的情况下实现完整语音能力，挑战“大模型=好”的常规认知。文章可能涉及训练效率、就地推理与对边缘AI的影响。

items.title_en: Clinical failure rates over the decades: yikes
items.title_zh: 几十年来的临床失败率：令人震惊
items.summary_en: A provocative look at long-term clinical failure rates, challenging narratives of steady medical progress. The discussion highlights data interpretation, trial design, and the role of AI in accelerating or complicating outcomes.
items.summary_zh: 对长期临床失败率的挑衅性观察，质疑医疗进步的单向叙事。讨论聚焦数据解读、试验设计，以及 AI 在加速或复杂化结果方面的作用。

items.title_en: Cloudflare's new AI traffic options for customers
items.title_zh: Cloudflare 为客户推出的新 AI 流量选项
items.summary_en: Cloudflare introduces AI-focused traffic options to help customers optimize routes, rate limits, and compute for AI workloads. The move could impact edge compute, bot mitigation, and how teams deploy AI services at scale.
items.summary_zh: Cloudflare 为客户推出面向 AI 的流量选项，帮助优化 AI 工作负载的路由、速率限制与计算。此举可能影响边缘计算、机器人防护，以及大规模部署 AI 服务的方式。

items.title_en: Show HN: Brolly, a plain-text weather forecast site
items.title_zh: Show HN: Brolly — 纯文本天气预报站点
items.summary_en: Brolly delivers weather forecasts in plain text, prioritizing readability, speed, and low bandwidth. It demonstrates that simple text formats can be highly actionable and accessible, particularly in bandwidth-constrained or low-resource environments.
items.summary_zh: Brolly 提供纯文本天气预报，强调可读性、速度和低带宽。它证明了简洁的文本格式在带宽受限或资源有限的场景中也能提供高效且易用的天气信息。

items.title_en: LLM Usage in Debian: Three Proposals
items.title_zh: Debian 中的 LLM 使用：三种提案
items.summary_en: Three proposals outline how Debian communities might approach LLM tooling, licensing, and safety in open-source packaging and user experience. The ideas balance freedom, security, and practical AI integration for Debian users.
items.summary_zh: 三种提案描述了 Debian 社区在开源打包、许可与安全方面引入 LLM 工具的路径。思路力求在自由、安全与对 Debian 用户的实用 AI 集成之间取得平衡。

items.title_en: Systems and Delays
items.title_zh: 系统与延迟
items.summary_en: An essay about how large systems encounter delays due to complexity, policy, and human factors. It offers patterns and design choices to reduce latency and improve reliability in real-world workflows.
items.summary_zh: 一篇关于大系统因复杂性、政策与人为因素而产生延迟的文章。提出减少时延、提升真实世界工作流可靠性的设计模式与思路。

items.title_en: The Dark Night of Mathematics
items.title_zh: 数学的黑暗之夜
items.summary_en: A meditation on the challenging, sometimes inaccessible nature of advanced mathematics. It surveys why deep problems feel like a dark night to students yet reveal profound beauty to those who persevere. The piece may resonate with researchers who face long horizons between insight and result.
items.summary_zh: 这是一篇关于高等数学艰深与难以捉摸本质的沉思。它探讨为何深奥问题让人望而却步，却在坚持中展现出深刻的美感。对长期从事研究的读者尤其有共鸣，强调耐心与毅力的重要性。

items.title_en: Running a 28.9M parameter LLM on an $8 microcontroller
items.title_zh: 在8美元微控制器上运行28.9M参数的LLM
items.summary_en: Demonstrates an LLM with 28.9M parameters running on a microcontroller costing around $8, using quantization or sparse techniques. It signals progress in true edge AI, with tradeoffs in speed, memory, and capability.
items.summary_zh: 展示了一款28.9M参数的语言模型在约8美元的微控制器上运行，通常通过量化或稀疏技术实现。这标志着边缘 AI 的实际进展，同时带来速度、内存与能力的权衡。

items.title_en: Producing ammonia and fertiliser using wind power in Morris, Minnesota
items.title_zh: 明尼苏达州莫里斯利用风能生产氨和肥料
items.summary_en: A wind-powered ammonia production and fertilizer demonstration in Morris, Minnesota demonstrates blending renewables with chemical manufacturing. The project aims to decarbonize fertilizer production, showing how variable wind energy can be coupled with industrial processes and what that means for rural energy resilience.
items.summary_zh: 明尼苏达州莫里斯的风能制氨与肥料示范项目将可再生能源与化工生产结合，探索在风力波动下维持工业过程的方法。此举旨在降低肥料生产的碳排放，并提升农村能源的韧性与自给能力。

items.title_en: Bitchat is now on Radicle
items.title_zh: Bitchat 现已接入 Radicle
items.summary_en: Bitchat has joined the Radicle network, enabling decentralized, peer-to-peer hosting and collaboration for chat-related content with versioned controls.
items.summary_zh: Bitchat 已接入 Radicle 网络，实现去中心化的点对点托管与版本化协作，提升聊天相关内容的开放性与可控性。

items.title_en: Hannah Fry Wins the Leelavati Prize in 2026 for Mathematics Outreach
items.title_zh: 汉娜·弗莱获2026年 Leelavati 数学传播奖
items.summary_en: Hannah Fry is awarded the Leelavati Prize for mathematics outreach, recognizing her work turning complex math ideas into accessible public-facing content. The award underscores the value of science communication in expanding participation in STEM and inspires broader engagement with mathematical ideas.
items.summary_zh: 汉娜·弗莱因其将复杂数学观念转化为易于大众理解的内容而获颁 Leelavati 数学传播奖，肯定了她在科学传播方面的贡献。该奖项强调了公众沟通在扩大 STEM 参与度方面的重要性，并激励更多人关注与学习数学。

items.title_en: Tile's security is so bad it's a feature for stalkers
items.title_zh: Tile 的安全性糟糕到成了跟踪者的利器
items.summary_en: Tile's security is so weak that it effectively enables stalking, highlighting the vulnerabilities of consumer trackers. It underscores why privacy-by-design matters even for simple devices.
items.summary_zh: Tile 的安全性极差，导致被用于跟踪等隐私侵犯的风险。文章讨论了从账户劫持到位置信息泄露等潜在风险，以及厂商应如何改进。强调即便是简单设备也要把隐私设计放在优先位置。

items.title_en: If coding has been solved, why does software keep getting worse?
items.title_zh: 如果编码已被解决，软件为何还在变坏？
items.summary_en: Argues that while fundamentals of programming haven't been solved, software quality keeps deteriorating due to incentives, complexity, and rushed delivery. The piece critiques hype and explores how teams manage complexity, proposing signals for healthier practices like modularity and testing.
items.summary_zh: 文章认为编程基础并未真正被解决，但软件质量仍在恶化，原因在于激励、复杂度与匆促交付。批评行业热潮背后的错配，讨论如何通过模块化、测试等方式提升软件质量。

items.title_en: Writing by hand is good for your brain
items.title_zh: 手写对大脑有益
items.summary_en: Handwriting engages motor memory and deeper processing, often boosting recall more than typing for learning tasks. The act of forming letters seems to strengthen neural connections that support long-term memory and understanding. For students and knowledge workers, mixing handwritten notes with digital tools can improve retention.
items.summary_zh: 手写能激活运动记忆并促使更深入的信息处理，常常比打字在学习任务中带来更高的记忆保留。手写过程有助于强化支持长期记忆和理解的神经连接。对于学生和知识工作者，混合使用手写笔记与数字工具有利于提升记忆留存。

items.title_en: Nvidia, Microsoft, Meta warn against overregulating open-weight models
items.title_zh: 英伟达、微软、Meta 警告勿过度监管开放权重模型
items.summary_en: NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Meta warn against overregulating open-weight models, arguing that heavy-handed rules could hamper innovation and push developers to closed ecosystems. They advocate targeted, risk-based oversight rather than broad bans, stressing practical governance over blanket prohibitions.
items.summary_zh: 英伟达、微软、Meta 警告不要对开放权重模型进行过度监管，担心会抑制创新并推动开发者转向封闭生态系统。他们主张以风险为基础的、有针对性的监管，而非全面禁令，强调治理应兼顾现实世界的应用场景。

items.title_en: Memory Safety Absolutists
items.title_zh: 内存安全至上主义者
items.summary_en: Advocates for strict memory-safety in software, arguing for safer languages and practices to prevent vulnerabilities, while weighing tradeoffs in performance and flexibility.
items.summary_zh: 倡导软件严格的内存安全，主张更安全的语言与实践以防止漏洞，同时权衡性能与灵活性的取舍。

items.title_en: My security camera shipped a GitHub admin token in its login page
items.title_zh: 我的安防摄像头在登录页暴露了一个 GitHub 管理员令牌
items.summary_en: A security camera shipped with a GitHub admin token embedded in its login page, potentially exposing credentials to anyone who visits. This incident highlights IoT authentication risks, insecure UI design, and the importance of secure firmware updates and token rotation.
items.summary_zh: 安防摄像头的登录页暴露了一个 GitHub 管理员令牌，可能被任意访问者利用。这一事件凸显物联网认证风险、界面安全设计不足，以及对固件更新和令牌轮换的迫切需求。

items.title_en: Multicast TV Distribution on My Home Network
items.title_zh: 在家庭网络中进行组播电视分发
items.summary_en: An ISP-independent approach for distributing TV streams over a home network using multicast reduces redundant data and improves efficiency for multi-room viewing. The project explores practical setups, hardware requirements, and potential privacy or QoS considerations.
items.summary_zh: 在家庭网络中通过组播技术分发电视流，可以减少重复数据传输，提升多房间观看的带宽利用率。该文章探讨了可行的设置、所需硬件，以及隐私与服务质量等潜在考量。

items.title_en: Be skeptical of OpenAI's rogue hacker agent story
items.title_zh: 对 OpenAI 的 rogue hacker agent 故事保持怀疑
items.summary_en: Questioning the veracity of a reported OpenAI rogue hacker agent incident, the piece argues for skepticism and better verification in AI security reporting. It discusses how sensational stories can mislead about AI autonomy and security risk.
items.summary_zh: 文章对关于 OpenAI 失控黑客代理的报道保持怀疑，强调需要更严格的核验与背景信息。讨论此类新闻对 AI 安全感知的影响以及报道方式的影响。

items.title_en: Taylor Farms Called White House to Try to Delay Cyclospora Recall
items.title_zh: Taylor Farms 致函白宫，试图延缓 Cyclospora 召回
items.summary_en: A major produce producer reportedly asked the White House to delay a Cyclospora recall, highlighting tensions between public health safety and corporate influence. The episode raises questions about regulatory leverage, transparency in recalls, and supply-chain responsibility. It underscores how industry pressure can intersect with food-safety actions.
items.summary_zh: 据报道，一家大型农产品公司曾请求白宫推迟环孢子虫召回，凸显公共卫生安全与企业影响力之间的张力。此事引发关于监管杠杆、召回透明度和供应链责任的讨论，显示行业压力可能影响食品安全决策。

items.title_en: Engineering management after the cost of code collapsed
items.title_zh: 代码成本崩塌后的工程管理
items.summary_en: With the apparent drop in the cost of coding due to automation and AI-assisted tooling, engineering management should rethink incentives and team structure. The piece argues for sharpening focus on system design, governance, and long-term maintainability to avoid brittle architectures as velocity increases.
items.summary_zh: 随着编码成本因自动化与 AI 辅助工具而下降，工程管理应重新审视激励机制和团队结构。文章主张将重点转向系统设计、治理和长期可维护性，以免在拉动速度时产生脆弱的架构。

items.title_en: The Fedora 45 Sausage Factory
items.title_zh: Fedora 45 的香肠工厂
items.summary_en: A critique of Fedora 45's release process, using the ‘sausage factory’ metaphor to describe the churn of features, fixes, and QA that culminate in a new release. It highlights tensions between rapid shipping and maintaining stability in a community-driven distro.
items.summary_zh: 以“香肠工厂”为比喻，批评 Fedora 45 的发布过程，描述功能整合、修复与质量保证的集约化流程。凸显在社区驱动的发行中，快速发布与稳定性之间的矛盾。

items.title_en: Government orders GitHub to remove Bluetooth-based chat app Bitchat: Jack Dorsey
items.title_zh: 政府要求 GitHub 下架蓝牙聊天应用 Bitchat，涉及安全担忧
items.summary_en: A government directive orders removal of a Bluetooth-based chat app linked to a high-profile figure, citing security concerns. The case highlights how policy actions intersect with platform hosting and privacy in distributed apps.
items.summary_zh: 政府指令要求下架与高知名人物相关的蓝牙聊天应用，因安全担忧而采取行动。此事凸显政策行为与平台托管、隐私在分布式应用场景中的交叉影响。

items.title_en: Opus 5 is currently #1 on Artificial Analysis Intelligence Leaderboard
items.title_zh: Opus 5 现居 Artificial Analysis Intelligence 榜单第一
items.summary_en: Opus 5 tops a prominent AI analysis leaderboard, signaling rapid progress and intense competition in model evaluation. Such rankings influence funding, collaboration, and which tools or approaches researchers pursue next. The momentum underscores how benchmarks shape the AI development landscape.
items.summary_zh: Opus 5在一个重要的人工分析榜单上排名第一，显示模型评估方面的快速进展与激烈竞争。此类排名会影响资金、合作机会以及研究者选择的工具或方法，凸显基准在塑造AI发展格局中的作用。

items.title_en: MouthPad: A Tongue-Controlled Touchpad
items.title_zh: MouthPad：舌控触控板
items.summary_en: Introduces a tongue-controlled input device that doubles as a mouth-based touchpad, aiming at accessibility and hands-free computing. The concept explores new interaction modes for assistive tech, gaming, and lightweight interfaces.
items.summary_zh: 介绍一种舌控输入设备，同时充当口腔触控板，旨在提升无障碍与免手操作计算体验。概念探讨对辅助技术、游戏与简约界面的新兴交互模式。

items.title_en: Wind turbine is being used to produce zero-carbon "green ammonia" fertilizer
items.title_zh: 风力涡轮正在用于生产零碳“绿色氨”肥料
items.summary_en: Wind power drives electrochemical or Haber-Bosch style ammonia production, enabling green ammonia for fertilizer without fossil fuels. This demonstrates how renewables can decarbonize chemical feedstocks and supply chains.
items.summary_zh: 风力涡轮为生产零碳“绿色氨”肥料提供动力，推动不依赖化石燃料的氨制备。此举展示了可再生能源如何实现化学品生产的脱碳化，影响农业供应链。

items.title_en: Postgres LISTEN/NOTIFY actually scales
items.title_zh: Postgres LISTEN/NOTIFY 真正具备可扩展性
items.summary_en: New findings show PostgreSQL's LISTEN/NOTIFY can scale under heavier workloads than commonly assumed. The write-up covers architectural tweaks and practical guidelines to sustain pub/sub style notifications at higher throughputs, including replication-aware patterns. That matters for real-time dashboards and event-driven systems that rely on Postgres as a backbone.
items.summary_zh: 新发现表明 PostgreSQL 的 LISTEN/NOTIFY 在高负载下其实可以实现较好的扩展性。文中讨论了架构优化与实操要点，帮助在高吞吐场景中维持发布-订阅型通知，包含与复制相关的考虑。对依赖 Postgres 进行实时仪表盘和事件驱动架构的开发者尤为相关。

items.title_en: Bringing PyTorch Monarch to AMD GPUs
items.title_zh: 把 PyTorch Monarch 带到 AMD GPU 平台
items.summary_en: PyTorch Monarch, designed to accelerate training and inference of large models, is now supported on AMD GPUs via ROCm. This expands access to high-performance AI workloads beyond NVIDIA hardware, helping AMD users run distributed training from a single controller. The move broadens hardware choices for large-scale ML teams and may spur more cross-vendor collaboration.
items.summary_zh: PyTorch Monarch 旨在加速大模型的训练与推理，现在通过 ROCm 获得对 AMD GPU 的支持。这扩展了高性能 AI 工作负载对非 NVIDIA 硬件的可用性，帮助 AMD 用户在单控制器下实现分布式训练。这一举措为大型 ML 团队带来更多硬件选择，并可能促进跨厂商协作。

items.title_en: 'AI Mania Is Eviscerating Global Decision-Making'
items.title_zh: AI 疯狂正在侵蚀全球决策
items.summary_en: A provocative column argues that AI hype and overreliance erode human oversight in governance and business, urging smarter policy guardrails and accountability. It warns against letting automated systems take the driver seat in critical decisions.
items.summary_zh: 一篇挑衅性的专栏认为人工智能的炒作与过度依赖正在侵蚀治理与商业中的人类监督，主张建立更智能的政策边界与问责机制，并警惕让自动化系统主导关键决策。

items.title_en: ARC-AGI Leaderboard
items.title_zh: ARC-AGI 榜单
items.summary_en: ARC-AGI Leaderboard tracks performance on tasks that require broad, general intelligence. It highlights what current systems excel at and where generalist reasoning remains elusive, guiding researchers and funders toward fruitful directions. The leaderboard serves as a public yardstick for evaluating progress toward AGI.
items.summary_zh: ARC-AGI 榜单汇集多项基准测试结果，评估系统在广义智能任务上的表现。它揭示当前系统的强项与短板，指引研究者与资助方关注更具潜力的研究方向，成为衡量向通用人工智能迈进的公开标尺。

items.title_en: Show HN: Writemark, a dependency free web component for inline Markdown editing
items.title_zh: Writemark：一个无依赖的内联 Markdown 编辑 Web 组件
items.summary_en: Writemark is a lightweight, dependency-free web component that enables inline Markdown editing, ideal for embedding in static sites without build tooling. It emphasizes simplicity and portability for developers who want minimal setup.
items.summary_zh: Writemark 是一个轻量级、无依赖的 Web 组件，支持内联 Markdown 编辑，适合在静态站点中嵌入，无需构建工具。它强调简单性与可移植性，降低初始集成成本。

items.title_en: Em dashes are amazing
items.title_zh: 破折号真的很棒
items.summary_en: A short ode to em dashes, arguing for their utility in typography and writing style, with examples on when and how to use them effectively.
items.summary_zh: 短评式文章赞美破折号在排版中的作用，讨论其可读性与风格贡献，并给出使用场景。

items.title_en: Becoming a Research Engineer at a Big LLM Lab
items.title_zh: 在大型 LLM 实验室成为研究工程师
items.summary_en: Offers insights into becoming a research engineer at a major LLM lab, covering required skills, typical interview topics, and career pathways in cutting-edge AI research.
items.summary_zh: 提供在大型 LLM 实验室成为研究工程师的见解，涵盖所需技能、常见面试话题与前沿 AI 研究中的职业路径。

items.title_en: Politician reads AI prompt during assembly
items.title_zh: 议会中政客朗读了 AI 提示词
items.summary_en: A politician reportedly read an AI-generated prompt during a legislative session, highlighting usability, ethics, and governance questions around AI-assisted discourse in government.
items.summary_zh: 有报道称某位政客在议会发言中朗读了 AI 生成的提示词，凸显了政府场景中对 AI 助力表达的伦理与治理问题。

items.title_en: Half-Life 2 running natively on HaikuOS
items.title_zh: HaikuOS 上 Half-Life 2 原生运行
items.summary_en: Half-Life 2 now runs natively on HaikuOS, showcasing progress in game compatibility and driver support for the niche OS. It demonstrates the vitality of hobbyist ecosystems and the potential for broader software ecosystems on smaller platforms.
items.summary_zh: Half-Life 2 现已在 HaikuOS 上原生运行，展示了该小众操作系统在游戏兼容性与驱动支持方面的进展，体现了爱好者生态的活力以及小众平台上扩大软件生态的潜力。

items.title_en: Scanwheel is a drum style mechanical television you can build yourself
items.title_zh: Scanwheel：一款可自行组装的鼓式机械电视
items.summary_en: This project presents a drum-scanner style mechanical TV that hobbyists can assemble at home. It blends retro display tech with accessible build instructions, offering a tangible take on how mechanical scanning works. It's both a nostalgic art piece and a practical DIY electronics project.
items.summary_zh: 该项目介绍了一种可在家动手组装的鼓式机械电视，采用节奏感十足的机械扫描方式。它将复古显示技术与易于获取的组装指南结合起来，直观展示机械扫描的原理。既是怀旧的艺术作品，也是一个实用的 DIY 电子项目。

items.title_en: IRGC claims it destroyed Amazon's Bahrain data center
items.title_zh: 伊朗革命卫队称摧毁亚马逊在巴林的数据中心
items.summary_en: An IRGC-linked claim alleges destruction of a data center in Bahrain, raising questions about attribution and the risk to critical infrastructure. Verification is unclear, but such statements amplify concerns about cyber violence and regional security.
items.summary_zh: 伊朗革命卫队相关方声称摧毁巴林的一座数据中心，引发对归因和关键基础设施风险的讨论。尚无独立核实，但此类表述放大了对网络暴力与区域安全的担忧。

items.title_en: UK AISI / Caisi Preliminary Assessment of Kimi K3's Cyber Capabilities
items.title_zh: 英国 AISI/CAISI 对 Kimi K3 的网络能力初步评估
items.summary_en: A UK analysis by AISI/CAISI provides a preliminary assessment of the Kimi K3 cyber capabilities, evaluating threat potential, use cases, and defense considerations. The preliminary findings help policymakers and security researchers understand how the tool might be deployed and what mitigations are needed.
items.summary_zh: 英国 AISI/CAISI 对 Kimi K3 的网络能力进行了初步评估，关注潜在威胁、应用场景及防护要点。该初步结果有助于决策者与安全研究者理解该工具的部署风险，并提出相应的缓解措施。

items.title_en: Brazilian farmers tokenized dairy cows to get loans, bypassing bank limits
items.title_zh: 巴西农民用奶牛代币化获得贷款，绕过银行放贷限额
items.summary_en: Farmers tokenized dairy cows as digital assets to secure loans, sidestepping traditional bank lending limits. The approach raises questions about collateralization, regulatory oversight, and the risks of tokenizing physical goods for finance.
items.summary_zh: 巴西农民将奶牛进行数字化代币化以获得贷款，从而绕开银行对贷款的上限。此举引发对抵押品、监管和将实物资产代币化融资的风险等问题的关注。

items.title_en: Buz – A fork of Bun using modern Zig, with sub-1s incremental builds
items.title_zh: Buz — 用 Zig 实现的 Bun 派生，具亚秒级增量构建
items.summary_en: Buz is a Bun fork implemented in Zig that promises sub-second incremental builds, accelerating developer feedback for JavaScript tooling. It aims to be a drop-in replacement with a modern, faster build pipeline.
items.summary_zh: Buz 是用 Zig 实现的 Bun 派生，承诺实现亚秒级增量构建，加速 JavaScript 工具链的开发反馈。目标是成为无缝替代品，提供更快的构建流水线。

items.title_en: Don't Take the Black Pill [video]
items.title_zh: 别被黑色药丸误导 [视频]
items.summary_en: A video discussing the idea of the 'black pill' and why one should resist certain pessimistic narratives. It may explore tech or AI culture and mental models.
items.summary_zh: 视频讨论所谓的“黑药丸”心态在科技话语中的影响，提示人们对相关观点保持警惕，强调理性思考。

items.title_en: The Silurian Hypothesis (2020)
items.title_zh: 志留纪假说（2020）
items.summary_en: This is a thought experiment about detecting signs of a pre-human civilization in Earth's geological record, challenging what evidence of ancient technosignatures would look like and how hard it would be to recognize them. The piece imagines what signatures—if any—could survive, and what detection would imply for archaeology and SETI.
items.summary_zh: 这是一个关于在地球地质记录中检测前人类文明迹象的思想实验，质疑古代技艺信号可能的证据 shape 以及被识别的难度。文章设想若留下痕迹，应该是什么样子，以及被发现会对考古学和地外文明研究意味着什么。

items.title_en: Show HN: Echo – Fable-level results at 1/3 the cost using open-weight models
items.title_zh: Show HN：Echo——用开放权重模型以三分之一成本获得同级别结果
items.summary_en: Echo demonstrates top-tier results at about one-third the cost by using open-weight models. This highlights the viability of open-weight AI for cost-sensitive deployments, though tradeoffs in support and ecosystem maturity remain.
items.summary_zh: Echo 在开放权重模型的帮助下，以约三分之一的成本取得接近顶级基准的结果，显示开源权重在降低 AI 部署成本方面的潜力。与此同时，生态成熟度和技术支持等取舍需要考虑。

items.title_en: Extinct Media Museum Tokyo
items.title_zh: 东京灭绝媒体博物馆
items.summary_en: The Extinct Media Museum in Tokyo preserves obsolete media formats and devices, offering a lens into how information was produced, stored, and consumed across eras. It highlights challenges in preserving digital memory as technology evolves and fades.
items.summary_zh: 东京灭绝媒体博物馆收藏并展示已过时的媒介与设备，提供穿越多时代的信息生产、存储与传播的视角。它凸显在技术迅速迭代中保存数字记忆所面临的挑战与脆弱性。

items.title_en: Show HN: SpinWin – A macOS menu bar app to visually rotate or spin any window
items.title_zh: Show HN：SpinWin――可视化旋转任意窗口的 macOS 菜单栏应用
items.summary_en: Introduces SpinWin, a macOS menu bar tool that visually rotates or spins any window, showcasing innovative window management and potential UX experiments.
items.summary_zh: 介绍 SpinWin，一款在 macOS 菜单栏中的工具，能够直观地旋转任意窗口，展示创新的窗口管理和潜在的用户体验实验。

items.title_en: I regret migrating to Codeberg
items.title_zh: 我后悔迁移到 Codeberg
items.summary_en: A personal critique of migrating to Codeberg, weighing issues like reliability, community, and tools against the allure of alternative platforms.
items.summary_zh: 作者分享迁移到 Codeberg 的个人体验，权衡可靠性、社区生态与工具链等因素，与其他平台的优劣进行比较。

items.title_en: Claude Cookbook
items.title_zh: Claude 使用手册
items.summary_en: Claude Cookbook compiles practical prompts, workflows, and recipes to get the most out of Claude across tasks like writing, data analysis, and coding. It highlights patterns for prompt engineering, guardrails, and chaining Claude's responses for robust outputs.
items.summary_zh: Claude Cookbook 汇集了在 Claude 上高效完成各类任务的提示、工作流程和使用范式，涵盖写作、数据分析与编程等场景。它总结了提示工程的常用模式、对话约束以及将多轮回复整合成可靠产出的策略。

items.title_en: Future euro banknote design proposals
items.title_zh: 未来欧元钞票设计提案
items.summary_en: The ECB lays out proposals for the next generation of euro banknotes, focusing on security upgrades, accessibility improvements, and sustainable production. The designs explore new visuals, tactile features, and anti-counterfeiting tech that will influence everyday cash handling and fintech interoperability.
items.summary_zh: 欧洲央行公布未来欧元钞票的设计提案，重点提升防伪、无障碍性与可持续性。设计强调新视觉、触感特征与反伪技术，对日常现金流通及金融科技的互操作性产生影响。

items.title_en: Prosecutor Investigating U.S. Boat Strikes Was Murdered in Ecuador
items.title_zh: 调查美国船只撞击案的检察官在厄瓜多尔遇害
items.summary_en: A prosecutor who was investigating U.S. boat-strike incidents was murdered in Ecuador, prompting concerns about safety for investigative journalists and the politics behind the case.
items.summary_zh: 正在调查美国船只撞击案的检察官在厄瓜多尔遇害，引发对调查记者安全和相关案件政治背景的担忧。

items.title_en: Show HN: I made some transistor animations
items.title_zh: Show HN：我做了一些晶体管动画
items.summary_en: I built a small set of transistor animations to visualize how transistors switch and amplify signals. The visuals offer a playful, educational look at electronics that can help beginners grasp semiconductor concepts.
items.summary_zh: 我做了一组晶体管动画，用来直观展示晶体管的开关与放大作用。直观的视觉效果既有趣又具教育意义，适合初学者理解半导体原理。

items.title_en: Harddrive Is Probably Full
items.title_zh: 硬盘快满了
items.summary_en: A contemplative post about disk space anxiety and how modern systems manage storage, with tips on cleanup and archiving.
items.summary_zh: 这篇博文反思了硬盘容量不足带来的焦虑，以及现代系统如何管理存储，并给出清理与归档的建议。

items.title_en: Sperm Whales blow bubbles to achieve restful, vertical sleep
items.title_zh: 抹香鲸吹泡泡以实现垂直睡眠，获得休憩状态
items.summary_en: New observations show sperm whales use bubble streams to rest vertically, a surprising adaptation for sleep in deep oceans. The behavior reveals complex, still-mysterious strategies whales employ to manage buoyancy, breathing, and sleep in extreme environments. This adds to our understanding of marine mammal sleep.
items.summary_zh: 新观测显示抹香鲸通过吹泡泡来竖直休息，是在深海睡眠中的一种出人意料的适应方式。这一行为揭示了鲸类在极端环境中管理浮力和呼吸以实现睡眠的复杂策略，丰富了对海洋哺乳动物睡眠的认识。

items.title_en: League of Legends designer shares game design field manual
items.title_zh: 英雄联盟设计师分享游戏设计手册
items.summary_en: Riot Games’ lead designer shares a practical field manual for game design, outlining principles, decision threads, and workflows for balancing systems, pacing, and player feedback in live-service games.
items.summary_zh: Riot 设计师分享了用于游戏设计的实用手册，概述了在持续运营的游戏中平衡系统、节奏与玩家反馈的原则、决策路径与工作流程。

items.title_en: My web version of Mars MIPS, now has built-in C compiler
items.title_zh: 我的 Mars MIPS 的网页版本现已内置 C 编译器
items.summary_en: The web Mars MIPS now includes a built-in C compiler. This lets you write, compile, and run C code directly in the browser, simplifying learning and experimentation.
items.summary_zh: Mars MIPS 的网页版本现在内置了 C 编译器。这样便可直接在浏览器中编写、编译并运行 C 代码，便于学习和试验。

items.title_en: Task-centered iproute2 user guide
items.title_zh: 以任务为中心的 iproute2 用户指南
items.summary_en: A practical iproute2 guide organized around real networking tasks rather than command syntax. It helps operators solve routing, policy, and QoS problems with concrete examples.
items.summary_zh: 围绕具体网络任务而非命令语法的 iproute2 实用指南。通过具体示例，帮助运维人员解决路由、策略和 QoS 等问题。

items.title_en: Unitree As2-W
items.title_zh: Unitree AS2-W
items.summary_en: Introduction to Unitree AS2-W, covering specs and potential applications for a new robot platform.
items.summary_zh: 介绍 Unitree 的 AS2-W 机器人平台，包含规格与潜在应用。

items.title_en: Codeberg Divides
items.title_zh: Codeberg 分裂
items.summary_en: Analyzes divisions within Codeberg, likely about governance, funding, or project direction, and what it means for open-source collaboration.
items.summary_zh: 分析 Codeberg 社区的分歧与治理问题，讨论对开源协作的影响。

items.title_en: Kimi K3 exploited the latest Redis server
items.title_zh: Kimi K3 利用最新 Redis 服务器的漏洞
items.summary_en: A report notes that a researcher used the latest Redis server to demonstrate a notable exploitation, highlighting ongoing security considerations for in-memory data stores. It illustrates how vendor updates and patch cycles interact with exploit discovery. The takeaway is the importance of timely updates and careful exposure of interfaces.
items.summary_zh: 报道指出研究者利用最新的 Redis 服务器演示了一个显著利用案例，凸显了内存数据存储的持续安全议题。它说明了厂商更新与漏洞披露之间的博弈以及打补丁的时效性。结论是要及时更新并谨慎暴露接口。

items.title_en: Show HN: I simulated closing the Strait of Hormuz on real oil trade data
items.title_zh: Show HN: 我用真实石油贸易数据模拟霍尔木兹海峡的关闭情景
items.summary_en: An experiment simulates what would happen if Hormuz were closed using real oil-trade data. It highlights potential disruptions to flows and price volatility and demonstrates how data-driven analyses can illuminate geopolitical risk. The approach shows how accessible data can model high-stakes scenarios without real-world disruption.
items.summary_zh: 通过真实石油贸易数据，作者模拟霍尔木兹海峡被关闭的情景，揭示能源流动与价格波动的潜在冲击。该方法展示了数据驱动分析在地缘政治风险评估中的应用，以及在不产生现实冲击的情况下进行情景探测的可行性。

items.title_en: The case for MUDs in modern times (2018)
items.title_zh: 现代仍需要 MUDs 的理由（2018）
items.summary_en: Makes the case that Multi-User Dungeons (MUDs) remain relevant today as flexible, low-resource shared worlds that enable emergent gameplay and community building. The piece outlines technical and social benefits, arguing that MUDs offer value as lightweight, persistent environments in an age of heavy client-server apps.
items.summary_zh: 文章主张在现代仍然需要 MUDs，作为灵活且资源消耗低的共享虚拟世界，能促进涌现式玩法与社群建设。文中概述了技术与社交层面的优势，认为 MUDs 在当下庞大客户端-服务器应用的时代仍具价值。

items.title_en: The front end framework for correctness: built on Effect, architected like Elm
items.title_zh: 注重正确性的前端框架：基于 Effect、仿 Elm 架构
items.summary_en: Introduces a front-end framework designed for correctness, built on Effect and architected like Elm. It emphasizes deterministic behavior, testability, and predictable UI rendering in a functional style.
items.summary_zh: 介绍一个注重正确性的前端框架，基于 Effect 并以 Elm 风格架构，强调可预测性、易测试和函数式 UI 行为。

items.title_en: Zero roadkill as Amazon canopy bridges secure 15,000 crossings
items.title_zh: 亚马逊树冠桥梁实现零车祸穿越，保障1.5万次动物跨越
items.summary_en: Wildlife canopy bridges across roads in the Amazon have achieved 15,000 crossings with zero observed roadkill. This demonstrates how engineered wildlife corridors can restore habitat connectivity at scale. The result offers a compelling precedent for integrating ecological data with infrastructure design.
items.summary_zh: 亚马逊林区的树冠通道让野生动物安全跨越公路，共记录了1.5万次穿越且未发现车祸。此举展示了通过工程化的野生动物走廊，在大规模范围内恢复栖息地连通性的可行性。该成果为将生态数据纳入基础设施设计提供了有力案例。

items.title_en: Fil-C: Garbage In, Memory Safety Out [video]
items.title_zh: Fil-C：垃圾入，内存安全出 [视频]
items.summary_en: Explains Fil-C, summarized as garbage in, memory safety out, via a video. Likely discusses how design decisions or tooling can enforce memory safety even with imperfect inputs, with implications for language design and runtime checks.
items.summary_zh: 视频探讨 Fil-C 这一概念，强调在潜在不安全输入下仍能实现内存安全的设计思路及实现要点，对语言和运行时安全有启示。

items.title_en: Firefox Containers Preview
items.title_zh: Firefox 容器功能预览
items.summary_en: Mozilla previews Firefox Containers, a feature that isolates you into separate profiles for each site or context, improving privacy and reducing tracking across contexts. The preview covers UX, security trade-offs, and integration with existing Firefox features. This matters for users juggling multiple personas or sensitive data.
items.summary_zh: Mozilla 公布了 Firefox 容器的预览版本，允许将不同站点或场景分隔到独立的容器中，以提升隐私与跨场景的跟踪防护。预览介绍了用户体验、安全权衡以及与现有功能的整合，对处理多种身份或敏感数据的用户尤为相关。

items.title_en: An old patent inspired the new "Y-zipper", a three-sided fastener
items.title_zh: 旧专利启发的新型三边扣件：Y-zipper
items.summary_en: An old patent sparked the creation of the Y-zipper, a three-sided fastener designed for easier alignment and secure closure. The concept blends geometry and manufacturing considerations to improve one-handed operation and versatility in tight spaces. It shows how archival patents can spur practical hardware innovations.
items.summary_zh: 一项旧专利促成了三边扣件“Y-zipper”的设计，旨在实现更易对齐与稳固闭合。该设计兼顾几何与制造考量，提升单手操作与在狭小空间中的灵活性。此案展示了存档专利如何激发实用的硬件创新。

items.title_en: Gsxui – Shadcn-style components for Go
items.title_zh: Gsxui：面向 Go 的 Shadcn 风格组件
items.summary_en: Gsxui brings Shadcn-style UI components to Go, enabling developers to build polished front-ends with a consistent design language. The project likely includes primitives, theming, and practical usage examples.
items.summary_zh: Gsxui 为 Go 提供 Shadcn 风格的 UI 组件，便于在 Go 应用中快速构建外观统一、现代感强的前端界面，通常配有设计系统与示例。

items.title_en: India's first privately-developed rocket reaches orbit on debut launch
items.title_zh: 印度首枚私营开发火箭首次进入轨道
items.summary_en: India's first privately-developed rocket reached orbit on its debut, signaling a new era for the country's private space sector. The milestone underscores growing private capabilities, potential disruption to traditional launch dynamics, and global competition in access to space.
items.summary_zh: 印度首枚私营开发火箭在首秀中进入轨道，标志着印度私营航天进入新阶段。此成就显示私人能力的提升，或对传统发射格局带来影响，并反映全球在进入太空领域的竞争加剧。

items.title_en: Building a Tiny 3D Renderer for a Tiny Handheld
items.title_zh: 为迷你手持设备打造迷你 3D 渲染器
items.summary_en: A hands-on devlog about building a compact software rasterizer for a handheld device with tight constraints. It discusses optimization choices, low-poly techniques, and what building graphics software on small hardware reveals about the limits of indie development.
items.summary_zh: 实操日志，讲述为受限的手持设备构建紧凑的软件栅格化渲染器。涵盖优化选择、低多边形技术，以及在小型硬件上开发图形软件所揭示的极限。

items.title_en: Stolen Buttons
items.title_zh: 被盗的按钮
items.summary_en: Stolen Buttons
items.summary_zh: 被盗的按钮

items.title_en: How My Images Are Dithered
items.title_zh: 我的图像被抖动处理
items.summary_en: The post explains why dithering is used when exporting images with limited color palettes, detailing techniques to preserve perceived detail and avoid banding. It shares practical tradeoffs and tips for artists and engineers working with constrained formats.
items.summary_zh: 文中介绍了在有限颜色调色板下导出图片时为何要进行抖动处理，阐述了保持视觉细节与避免色带的技巧与权衡。并给出在受限格式下的实用建议，面向艺术家与工程师。

items.title_en: The small, real, original web
items.title_zh: 小而真实的原始网络
items.summary_en: Argues for preserving a small, original web that values simplicity, openness, and privacy over heavy client-side frameworks. The piece contrasts modern social platforms with a leaner web and discusses ways to reclaim a more maintainable, interoperable internet.
items.summary_zh: 文章主张保留一个小而真实的原始网络，强调简洁、开放和隐私胜过繁重的前端框架。对比当今的社交通道，讨论如何重获一个更易维护、可互操作的互联网。

items.title_en: DuckPGQ – A DuckDB community extension for graph workloads
items.title_zh: DuckPGQ：DuckDB 的社区扩展，面向图工作负载
items.summary_en: DuckPGQ is a DuckDB community extension aimed at graph workloads, presumably enabling graph queries within DuckDB for analytics.
items.summary_zh: DuckPGQ 是 DuckDB 的社区扩展，面向图工作负载，可能实现对图数据的分析查询能力。

items.title_en: Programming language file extensions that match ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes
items.title_zh: 编程语言文件扩展名与 ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 国家代码的映射
items.summary_en: A quirky mapping shows programming language file extensions that collide with ISO country codes, prompting questions about naming conventions and potential tooling collisions.
items.summary_zh: 展示了编程语言文件扩展名与 ISO 国家代码冲突的有趣映射，提出命名规范和工具链冲突的思考。

items.title_en: Marimo now runs in PyCharm
items.title_zh: Marimo 现已在 PyCharm 运行
items.summary_en: Marimo now runs inside PyCharm, letting developers use its features directly from the IDE. The integration reduces context-switching and streamlines testing, especially for data science workflows. It exemplifies how niche runtimes gain adoption by embedding in popular development environments.
items.summary_zh: Marimo 现在可以在 PyCharm 中运行，开发者可在 IDE 内直接使用其功能。此举减少切换上下文并简化测试，尤其利于数据科学工作流的实现。体现了将小众运行时嵌入主流开发环境以提升采用率的趋势。

items.title_en: Designing an Ethernet Switch ASIC
items.title_zh: 以太网交换机ASIC的设计
items.summary_en: A deep dive into the hardware design challenges of a modern Ethernet switch ASIC, from packet buffering and fabric bandwidth to power and thermal constraints. It covers architectural tradeoffs that influence latency, throughput, and cost, and may illustrate a path from RTL to tapeout. The takeaway is how system-level constraints shape data-center networking chips.
items.summary_zh: 文章深入解析现代以太网交换机 ASIC 的设计难点，涵盖分组缓存、交换架构带宽、功耗与热管理等要点。讨论了影响延迟、吞吐和成本的架构权衡，并展示了从 RTL 到流片的实现路径。核心在于系统级约束如何塑造数据中心网络芯片的设计取舍。

items.title_en: NYC Apartment Aquaponics
items.title_zh: 纽约公寓水养鱼菜共生系统
items.summary_en: An NYC apartment aquaponics setup demonstrates how small spaces can blend fish farming with plant cultivation, recycling nutrients and reducing grocery reliance. The project covers design choices, energy considerations, and practical hurdles for home urban farming.
items.summary_zh: 纽约公寓中的水养鱼菜共生系统展示了在有限空间内实现鱼养与植物生长的可行性，利用循环养分减少对日常采购的依赖。项目讨论了设计选型、能耗和在城市居家环境落地所面临的实际挑战。

items.title_en: Spatial languages: Writing code in 2D
items.title_zh: 空间语言：用二维编写代码
items.summary_en: Explores programming languages designed to be written and read in two dimensions, where code can be laid out spatially to express structure and data flow.
items.summary_zh: 探讨以二维方式编写和阅读的编程语言，使代码在空间中排布以表达结构与数据流。讨论这类语言在可视化方面的潜在优势，以及远离传统文本编码的挑战。

items.title_en: Charles Ross spent 50 yrs building Star Axis naked-eye observatory in New Mexico
items.title_zh: 查尔斯·罗斯花费50年建造的新墨西哥肉眼观星地标《星之轴》
items.summary_en: A profile of Star Axis, a decades-spanning land-art project in New Mexico that invites naked-eye stargazing. It showcases long-horizon art intersecting with engineering, community, and public access to the night sky.
items.summary_zh: 关于 Star Axis——在新墨西哥持续数十年的地景艺术项目，旨在提供肉眼观星。展示了长期艺术与工程、社区与公众接入天际的交汇。

items.title_en: SIMD for Collision
items.title_zh: 用于碰撞检测的 SIMD 优化
items.summary_en: Vectorizing collision checks with SIMD can dramatically boost physics performance in engines like Box2D, improving frame rates on mobile and desktops. The post details practical techniques for data layout and SIMD usage to accelerate broad-phase and narrow-phase tests.
items.summary_zh: 通过 SIMD 对碰撞检测进行向量化可显著提升物理引擎的性能，提升移动端和桌面端的帧率。文中介绍了面向数据布局和指令集的实用技巧，用以加速广义和窄域阶段的碰撞测试。

items.title_en: GC and Exceptions in Wasmtime
items.title_zh: Wasmtime 的 GC 与异常机制
items.summary_en: Wasmtime’s discussion of GC and exceptions explains how WebAssembly’s future garbage collection and exception handling features fit into the runtime. It’s a signal of where WASM tooling is headed.
items.summary_zh: Wasmtime 正在探讨 WebAssembly 将来引入的垃圾回收和异常处理机制如何嵌入运行时。文章讲解了兼容性、内存管理的影响，以及 GC 与异常成熟后对性能与语言互操作性的潜在变化，折射出 WASM 工具链的发展方向。

items.title_en: PyPI Blog: Releases now reject new files after 14 days
items.title_zh: PyPI 博客：发布版本在14天后将拒绝新增文件
items.summary_en: PyPI now rejects new release files after 14 days to reduce stale artifacts and security risk. Maintainers may need to re-upload if they intend to publish updates after the window.
items.summary_zh: PyPI 现在在发布后14天内拒绝新增文件，以减少陈旧资源与安全风险；若需在窗口外继续发布更新，维护者需重新上传。

items.title_en: Book Corners: Community map of neighborhood book exchange spots
items.title_zh: Book Corners：社区书籍交换点地图
items.summary_en: Book Corners builds a community-driven map of neighborhood book-exchange spots, helping readers swap titles locally and discover new reads nearby. The project fosters grassroots sharing and strengthens local cultural networks.
items.summary_zh: Book Corners 构建了一个社区驱动的邻里书籍交换点地图，帮助读者就地互换书籍、发现附近的新书。该项目促进草根层面的分享，强化本地文化网络的连结。

items.title_en: Rethinking Legal Education in the AI Era
items.title_zh: AI 时代的法律教育再思考
items.summary_en: Law schools are rethinking curricula to address AI literacy, ethics, and risk management in practice. The piece outlines how curricula, accreditation, and interdisciplinary training may adapt to a world where AI increasingly intersects law.
items.summary_zh: 法学院正在重新设计课程，以应对 AI 素养、伦理与风险管理的现实需求。文章探讨课程、认证与跨学科学习如何适应 AI 与法律交叉的世界。

items.title_en: The footprints of every building in NYC
items.title_zh: 纽约市每栋建筑的足迹
items.summary_en: A data-driven project maps the footprint of every building in NYC, revealing urban density patterns and architectural footprints.
items.summary_zh: 这是一个数据驱动的项目，绘出纽约市每栋建筑的轮廓与占地，揭示城市密度与建筑特征。文中介绍数据源、粒度以及对城市规划、隐私和基础设施的潜在影响。

items.title_en: PartialString – A finite-difference time-domain physical modelling synthesiser
items.title_zh: PartialString：基于有限差分时域的物理建模合成器
items.summary_en: PartialString uses finite-difference time-domain methods to synthesize sounds via physical modeling, delivering acoustically grounded timbres. It showcases the trade-offs of FDTD-based synthesis—computational cost, stability, and integration with musical workflows.
items.summary_zh: PartialString 采用有限差分时域方法进行物理建模合成，从而生成更符合物理直觉的音色。项目揭示了 FDTD 合成在计算成本、稳定性及与音乐工作流整合等方面的权衡。

items.title_en: GDID Windows – Cut the tracker that follows you even under VPN
items.title_zh: GDID Windows：切断 VPN 下也会跟踪你的追踪器
items.summary_en: A privacy-focused Windows tool to cut a persistent tracker that survives VPN usage. The feature reportedly reduces cross-vpn fingerprinting by eliminating identifiers that survive network tunneling. It underscores how traditional OS telemetry can erode privacy, and why dedicated privacy tooling matters.
items.summary_zh: 这是一个用于在 Windows 上切断在 VPN 下仍会跟踪用户的持久识别符的隐私工具。该工具能降低通过 VPN 漂移的指纹追踪风险，强调了操作系统遥测对隐私的潜在侵扰，以及隐私工具的重要性。

items.title_en: Re: Bye Bye Gravatar
items.title_zh: 关于告别 Gravatar 的回应
items.summary_en: It weighs privacy, portability, and control considerations for platforms relying on avatars.
items.summary_zh: 文章讨论 Gravatar 的衰退及为何在线头像可能转向自托管或去中心化的解决方案，权衡隐私、可携带性与对头像的控制等因素。
